title: CWB Gaming — Platform Admin
tagline: The control room of a game top-up marketplace
description: The platform admin behind the CWB Gaming demo: "Needs your attention today" (seller applications, orders held for a safety check, disputes, payout requests), seller KYC review with approve / reject / request info, orders across every seller with confirm-payment, release, refund and reassign, disputes with side-by-side evidence and refund / pay seller / split, commission rules and payouts, fraud & risk with 🟢 Trusted / 🟡 New / 🔴 Verify buyers and seller standing, reviews, reports, staff roles and the activity log — in Bangla and English. It is the marketplace's real admin code running in the browser, sharing its data with the marketplace and seller demos.
highlights: Opens straight into the dashboard — two-step sign-in is on, the demo accepts code 123456
A pending seller application (NightOwl Codes) to approve or reject in one tap
A first big order held after payment — release it and the code is delivered
A dispute waiting for a decision, with the buyer's and the seller's side
Payout requests to approve and mark paid; CSV export on every list
SKUs GAME-PUBG-660UC-S014 and invoices INV-CWB-YYYYMMDD-#### generated by the system

credentials.label: Platform admin sign-in
credentials.note: Opens already signed in. After Sign out, sign back in with these and authenticator code 123456 (the demo accepts it; the live site needs a real authenticator app). Everything is fictional demo data kept in your browser; add ?demo-reset to the address to start fresh.
